bar-tautni.name: Bar Ta’utni
bar-tautni.bio: A sage known only by this name, whose explanation Reish Lakish passes on in Keritot 4b.
bar-tautni.prompt: A quiet sage in his 50s with a greying beard and a plain brown wool mantle, with a reserved, thoughtful expression, as if offering a careful explanation; background of limestone arches and olive trees.

rabbi-illa.name: Rabbi Illa
rabbi-illa.bio: Amora of the Land of Israel, a student of Rabbi Yoḥanan.
rabbi-illa.prompt: An earnest scholar of the Land of Israel in his 50s with a dark beard touched with grey and a sea-green linen mantle, with a careful, attentive expression; background of limestone arches and olive trees.
